system.description:
An expansion of Horrid Reality that lets the Ravnos inflict a terrifying, illusory catastrophe on multiple victims at once, each convinced they alone are experiencing it.

System: The Ravnos spends one Blood Point per target plus two Willpower, then rolls Manipulation + Subterfuge once, comparing the result against each target's Perception + Self-Control individually. Any target who fails believes the Horrid Reality is happening to them personally.

MET: Elder Discipline. The Ravnos spends one Willpower Trait per target (maximum five targets) plus one Social Trait, bid against all targets simultaneously; each target's result is compared individually rather than as a group challenge. Any target who loses suffers the full effects of Horrid Reality.
